# nlohmann/json

`json.hpp` is the single-header build of [nlohmann/json](https://github.com/nlohmann/json),
copied unmodified from tag `v3.11.3`:

    single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp
    sha256 9bea4c8066ef4a1c206b2be5a36302f8926f7fdc6087af5d20b417d0cf103ea6

`LICENSE.MIT` is that tag's licence file, also copied unmodified. Note that
upstream's licence file and the SPDX header inside `json.hpp` disagree on the
copyright year, 2013-2022 against 2013-2023; both are reproduced as upstream
wrote them rather than reconciled here.

To update, replace both files from the same tag and record the new version and
hash above.
